description: Only advisories with no safe patch for launch. Each entry needs a matching residual-risk note in docs/security/baseline.md. Any new high/critical advisory fails CI.

allowlistedAdvisories.GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5: zod v3 memory exhaustion on oversized input; fixed only in zod >=4.6.6 (major migration incl. nestjs-zod). Mitigated by Fastify bodyLimit 1 MiB and .max() bounds on string inputs.
